documents.title: Guidance on the use of AI at Rutgers
documents.summary: Universitywide IT guidance on AI. It says AI guidance varies by instructor, but AI should not be treated as permissible for coursework unless instructors say so. It also covers approved tools, confidential data, verifying output and purchasing.
documents.stance_why: The page says AI "should not be considered permissible for coursework unless clearly stated or communicated by instructors", which is a ban unless permitted. It also says guidance "will typically vary depending on the discipline, course, and/or instructor", so the decision is largely handed to instructors, but the stated default is what binds when they are silent. I chose restrict over delegates for that reason.

documents.summary: An archived OTEAR page of advice and links on AI for faculty. It suggests assignment redesign, offers three sample syllabus statements, and leaves each course to choose. Most of the page is resource lists and event listings.
documents.stance_why: The page says "Develop clear policies for each course" and "Depending on whether AI tools will be banned or permitted, add text that clearly states the conditions specific for the course", then offers three sample statements (ban, brainstorm only, fully permitted with citation). It sets no rule itself, so delegates with tiers.
